fact: The author states that the national DHIS2 system is available in the DRC and that health facilities transmit data through it, though often incomplete or late.
The DHIS2 organisation states the DRC has used DHIS2 as a national-scale HMIS since 2013, for health programme planning and management at zonal, provincial and national levels.
RTI states the eIDSR disease surveillance system is integrated in the national DHIS2 platform and connects directly to the national health information system.
The Countdown analysis says DHIS2 data on facility reporting across the DRC's health zones and districts cover 2019-2024 and are of generally high quality.
The analysis gives DHIS2 reporting completeness rising to 99% in 2024, with about 90% for six key indicators.
